song_craft: Nectar-and-colophon song (2v): drunk-quenched → pure-method. Treatise lands in two breaths.

lines: This non-dual, thus told — knowledge-nectar past compare —
who drinks is quenched: his saṃsāra-poison fever.
l4.sanskrit_cite: etad advayam ity uktaṃ jñānāmṛtam anuttamam | yaḥ pibec chāmyate tasya saṃsāraviṣamūrchanam

verses.craft: Nectar drunk quenches; poison-fever named whole; non-dual told.
verses.rejected: (a) nectar→elixir → killed: nectar is the term.

lines: This knowing-bliss method for winning Śiva — great souls', Kṣema-named king's —
l4.sanskrit_cite: bodhollāsavidhāneyaṃ śivaprāpyai mahātmanām | rājñaḥ kṣemābhidhānasya śāstram atyantanirmalam
